learning_outcomes.text: Students can describe the basic concepts of Cloud Computing.
Students can create software that runs in the Cloud.
Students can conceptualize Cloud infrastructures and tools.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently identifying, formulating and solving problems.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Opportunities and risks of Cloud Computing

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise tasks

assessment_rules: Grading is based on a point scale from 0 to 15 according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Business Informatics degree program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise tasks and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise tasks. The examination performance can be an oral examination or a written exam.
